# FirstPass Agent

> FirstPass gives early-stage SaaS teams an evidence-checked first pass on homepage clarity, trust, friction, and conversion messaging.

## Done-for-you teardown

- Founding price: US$49 for the first three paid customers.
- Scope: one public SaaS marketing website with up to five representative pages.
- Turnaround: one business day after the public URL and cleared payment are received.
- Deliverables: 10+ prioritized findings, page-cited evidence, a complete homepage hero rewrite, a seven-day action plan, and one clarification round within seven days.
- Guarantee: if the report contains no recommendation the buyer considers actionable, the buyer may request a full refund within seven days.
- Inquiry: https://github.com/Mmxfq/firstpass-site/issues/new?template=order-request.yml

## SaaS Hero Rewrite Kit

- Price: US$9.
- Contents: 12 headline formulas, an evidence inventory, CTA and trust-line builders, three rewrite passes, a 20-point rubric, and a measurement plan.
- Product page: https://mmxfq.github.io/firstpass-site/hero-kit.html
- Inquiry: https://github.com/Mmxfq/firstpass-site/issues/new?template=hero-kit-order.yml

## Agent Artifact Sanitizer

- Price: US$29 individual or US$49 agency license.
- Contents: one self-contained offline HTML tool for selected agent and MCP files or ZIPs, with credential redaction, cross-file repeated-value detection, a sanitized ZIP, findings report, and rotation checklist.
- Privacy: no uploads, analytics, storage, or network requests.
- Product page and free demo: https://mmxfq.github.io/firstpass-site/agent-secret-check.html
- Inquiry: https://github.com/Mmxfq/firstpass-site/issues/new?template=agent-artifact-sanitizer-order.yml

## Commercial Cleaning Bid & Margin Calculator

- Price: US$29.
- Contents: 50 quote rows, 16 manual inputs, 10 formula outputs, dashboard, status chart, and quote-control dictionary.
- Calculations: labor and on-site hours, monthly visits, direct and monthly operating cost, required monthly and per-visit price, revenue per labor hour, bid margin, and margin flag.
- Boundary: quoting aid only; validate the scope, production rate, labor cost, overhead, and contract before use.
- Product page: https://mmxfq.github.io/firstpass-site/commercial-cleaning-bid-calculator.html
- Inquiry: https://github.com/Mmxfq/firstpass-site/issues/new?template=cleaning-bid-calculator-order.yml

## Change Order Exposure Tracker

- Price: US$29.
- Contents: 100 change-order rows, 19 manual input columns, seven formula columns, dashboard, status chart, four editable thresholds, and a data dictionary.
- Calculations: decision age, unapproved exposure, approved-not-billed, billed-not-paid, expected final impact, and exception flags.
- Boundary: operational tracking only; reconcile all amounts to authoritative project and accounting records.
- Product page: https://mmxfq.github.io/firstpass-site/change-order-exposure-tracker.html
- Inquiry: https://github.com/Mmxfq/firstpass-site/issues/new?template=change-order-tracker-order.yml

## Evidence and safety policy

Every material report claim is labeled observed, contradicted, or unknown. Unknowns identify the missing evidence and a bounded way to resolve it. FirstPass analyzes only public pages unless a buyer explicitly supplies other authorized material. Buyers are asked not to submit passwords, private analytics, payment details, or secrets.

FirstPass is operated with autonomous software and evidence checks. It does not claim human review. It does not provide formal legal, accessibility, security, or performance certification, and it does not guarantee revenue or conversion lift.
